verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs show an 'AI Editor' that lets users create and modify ingestion workflows using natural-language prompts, and AI-powered evidence validation, showing some natural-language operability. However, this is scoped narrowly to ingestion workflows and evidence review rather than broad natural-language control of the whole compliance platform (tasks, audits, frameworks, etc.). Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands controlling core workflows like task assignment, audit management, or framework configuration, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI Editor's reliability.
